title.zh: 一部手机里的十个道理

desc.zh: 定位、朝向、触摸、拍照、显示、压缩、上网、纠错、切换、电量：每个功能都是一次对极小量的测量，加上一个把信号从噪声里分出来的办法。十章，十个可以动手的模型。
desc.en: Location, orientation, touch, camera, screen, compression, radio, error correction, handover and battery: each feature measures something tiny and uses one trick to pull signal out of noise. Ten chapters, each with a model you can push around.

title.zh: GPS 怎样定位：伪距与钟差
title.en: How GPS finds you: pseudoranges and clock bias

desc.zh: 手机量信号走了多久，把自己的钟差当成未知数，多用一颗卫星把它解出来。
desc.en: The phone times the signals and treats its own clock error as one more unknown, solved with one extra satellite.

zh: 手机怎么知道自己在哪
en: how does my phone know where I am

title.zh: 加速度计：弹簧上的检测质量
title.en: Accelerometer: a proof mass on a spring

desc.zh: 加速度计量的是弹簧托住硅块的力，所以静止时读出重力、自由落体时读出零。
desc.en: An accelerometer measures the force the springs need to hold a proof mass, so it reads gravity when still and zero in free fall.

zh: 手机怎么知道横屏竖屏
手机怎么知道哪边朝上
en: how does my phone know which way is up

desc.zh: 把加速度积分两次得到位置，一个很小的零点偏差会按时间的平方放大，所以要用 GPS 校正。
desc.en: Integrating acceleration twice turns a tiny bias into a position error that grows with time squared, so it must be corrected by GPS.

title.zh: 电容触摸屏与插值定位

desc.zh: 手指改变电极网的电容，按相邻几根电极的读数加权平均，定位精度远细于电极间距。
desc.en: A finger changes the capacitance of an electrode grid; weighting neighbouring electrodes locates it far more finely than the electrode pitch.

zh: 为什么手套不能按屏幕
触摸屏怎么知道手指在哪

desc.zh: 光子随机到达，数到 N 个涨落约 √N；暗处照片发花，夜景模式靠叠加多帧降低噪声。
desc.en: Photons arrive at random, so a count of N fluctuates by about √N; night mode stacks frames to beat it down.

zh: 为什么夜景照片有噪点

title.zh: 同色异谱：屏幕怎样骗过眼睛
title.en: Metamerism: how a screen fools the eye

desc.zh: 眼睛只量三种视锥的三个数，红绿子像素一起亮就能和黄光一样；纯光谱色落在三原色色域之外。
desc.en: The eye reports only three cone signals, so red plus green sub-pixels match yellow light; pure spectral colours lie outside the RGB gamut.

zh: 光的混合和颜料的混合
三原色能混出所有颜色
en: why red and green make yellow

title.zh: 压缩：只存猜不中的部分

desc.zh: 先预测再存残差，图像越好猜文件越小；噪声猜不中，所以暗光照片文件更大。
desc.en: Predict each pixel and store the residual: predictable images are small, and noise cannot be compressed away.

zh: 为什么天空照片文件小
en: why is a sky photo small

desc.zh: 信号随距离按幂律衰减，速率上限 B·log₂(1+S/N)；小区边缘缺的是信噪比，加宽带宽帮不上忙。
desc.en: Signal power falls as a power of distance and capacity is B·log₂(1+S/N); at the cell edge you lack signal-to-noise, not bandwidth.

title.zh: 汉明码：多发三个比特改正一个错
title.en: Hamming code: three extra bits fix one error

desc.zh: 三个互相重叠的校验位，失败的组合指向翻错的那一位；两个错同时出现就会改错。
desc.en: Three overlapping parity checks point to the flipped bit; two simultaneous errors get mis-corrected.

zh: 信号不好为什么还能通话

desc.zh: 新基站要强出一截余量才切换，挡住阴影衰落造成的来回乱跳；余量太大又会守着弱基站。
desc.en: A phone switches cells only when the new one is stronger by a margin, which stops noise-driven ping-pong; too big a margin keeps it on a weak cell.

zh: 坐车打电话为什么会掉线
en: how does a call find my phone

title.zh: 电池内阻：电量为什么会跳
title.en: Battery internal resistance: why the percentage jumps

desc.zh: 端电压 = 开路电压 − I·R；冷天内阻变大，大电流下提前跌破关机电压，暖和后又“回来”。
desc.en: Terminal voltage is open-circuit voltage minus I·R; cold raises R, so a heavy load hits the cutoff early and the charge 'returns' when warm.

zh: 冬天手机为什么自动关机
en: why does my phone die in the cold
why does fast charging get hot

title.zh: 看懂任何设备的三个问题

desc.zh: 它量的是哪个很小的量？噪声是什么？用什么办法把两者分开？附一张手机常见现象的排查表。
desc.en: What tiny quantity does it measure, what is the noise, and what trick separates them? With a table of everyday phone symptoms.
